feeds.title: Junior Style
feeds.description: Junior Style brings you the best selection of designer clothing for children in one online hub.

feeds.title: Marie-Chantal Blog
feeds.description: Marie-Chantal is a fun, fresh and playful luxury childrenswear brand specialising in clothing for babies and children. Also Marie Chantal provides unique gift ideas.

feeds.title: Little Secrets Children's Clothing Blog
feeds.description: Covers Children's Clothing, Baby Girl Dresses, Baby Easter Outfits, Christmas Outfits, and Valentines Day Outfits. Little Secrets is a family-run business that specializes in designing bespoke personalized outfits and gifts for all the family and friends!

feeds.title: Blue Almonds Ltd Blog
feeds.description: I always felt strongly that my vision of Blue Almonds was to provide from mother to mother and I am delighted to say that over the years this is what it has become. Our business has originated from creating bespoke nurseries and we have stayed true to this core service all this time. As a small baby boutique in Kensington, we can add a personal touch to every element of your nursery and baby clothing needs.

feeds.title: City Kids Magazine » Kids Fashion
feeds.description: City Kids Magazine was born of Victoria Evans' frustration to find things to do with her young family. The magazine includes shopping, travel, food, education, fashion and intelligent journalism. In the following section of the magazine, you can find articles covering the latest trends, outfits, styling, and more in kids fashion.

feeds.title: Smudgetikka
feeds.description: Smudgetikka kids fashion blog is posted by Linda McLean, a professional in children's fashion who once worked with adults but finds the little ones so much more fun. Currently working as Fashion Editor at Family Traveller Magazine and with a vast array of experience to draw on she knows the best in the business and will bring you the hottest designer labels and the strongest trends in kidswear fashion right now.

feeds.title: The Adventure of Parenthood
feeds.description: A blog about the adventure of parenting; puschairs, cloth nappies, reviews and more

feeds.title: Mummy in the City » Baby Fashion
feeds.description: Mummy in the City is written by Tine Farstad, a London mum mostly running around in Fulham, Parsons Green, Chelsea, South Kensington and Battersea with her daughter and son.The blog, launched in August 2012, is focused on life with young children in South West London, and covers topics such as London activities for children, children's fashion and more.

feeds.title: Chalk Kids » Fashion
feeds.description: Chalk Kids is a UK parenting blog, dedicated to modern families. We aim to bring you the best in little fashion, crafty DIY's, honest product reviews and scrummy recipes. There's also plenty for the style conscious mum, from inspiring interiors, the low down from other mothers and on-the-go fashion and beauty tips

feeds.title: The Mummy Stylist » Clothing
feeds.description: This blog includes toddler fashion, family activities, interiors, upcycling, crafts, lifestyle from Sabrina.

feeds.title: Smudgetikka » Fashion
feeds.description: Smudgetikka kids fashion clothes blog is posted by Linda McLean, a professional in children's fashion who once worked with adults but finds the little ones so much more fun. With a vast array of editorial experience to draw on from You magazine and Junior magazine where she was a Fashion Director she knows the best in the business and will bring you the hottest designer labels and the strongest trends in kidswear fashion right now.

feeds.title: Lucy & Sam Blog
feeds.description: Born and raised in South London, Lucy & Sam is an organic fashion brand for babies and toddlers with big hearts and playful imaginations. Keep up to date with the latest from Lucy and Sam. As well as news, ideas, tips and much more!

feeds.title: BABI PUR Blog
feeds.description: Babipur is a family-owned retail store & brand. Ethically sourced products for babies, children and the whole family! Find articles on craft, STEM, real-life stories, Christmas, recipes, and more on the Babipur Blog.

feeds.title: Boy Wonder Blog
feeds.description: A creative mum's blog on setting up a business, parenting, kids fashion and all things ethical and sustainable. Boy Wonder is a sustainable kids fashion brand made in Britain featuring hand-drawn prints on organic cotton

feeds.title: Kathryns Blog
feeds.description: Interested in the latest designer childrenswear stories, news and industry trends? Explore Kathryn's blog for all the latest info in the world of kids' fashion. For over forty years Kathryn's has been serving clients with love, attention to detail and a commitment to providing beautiful, stylish children's clothing for every occasion. Our aim for the online store is to continue to evolve and to give our customers a new way to enjoy Kathryn's experience.

feeds.title: Scandi Mini Blog
feeds.description: Scandi Mini is an independent online children's boutique with over 150 brands from Scandinavia and beyond.

feeds.title: Claude & Co Blog
feeds.description: Claude & Co sells clothing for babies, children and some matching garbs for adults, designed and developed in the UK by our founder Abi. With standard 'unisex' newborn clothing being mostly white, we believe that not knowing the gender of your baby shouldn't mean you have to stick to monochrome outfits. We work around colours that we like and build on that with beautiful fabrics and shapes that don't feel gender-specific.

feeds.title: Frugi UK
feeds.description: Frugi is all about scrummy, organic cotton clothes for babies, kids and mums too! Welcome to the Frugi Blog. Here we'll keep you up to date with news on organic cotton clothes for babies and kids, as well as nursing and breastfeeding wear.
